name: LoadoutSwitcher
description: Hotkey switching of saved in-game loadouts (Role Plans), with toast feedback.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Stellar Settings — Hotkeys: the loadout group with apply.1–apply.8 bindings.

added: Pressing the hotkey of the loadout you already have equipped now re-applies its Deep-Slumber setup, so a psychoscope change that didn't take can be retried without switching to another loadout and back. If the setup is already in place, a green message confirms it.
